program.name: Morning 25
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: A short morning practice: cat-cow and salutations, a few standing poses, then something gentle on the floor.
program.about: A short practice for the start of the day, about twenty-five minutes. Cat-cow and sun salutations wake the spine, a few standing poses warm the legs, and a gentle floor pose ends it. Two versions alternate so mornings do not repeat. Levels II and III hold each pose a little longer. Good on its own or before a busy day.
